tables.title: Typical product life cycle phases
tables.section_title: Life cycle management with readout protection (RDP)
tables.text: Table 9, "Typical product life cycle phases", in section 3.7.1 (Life cycle management with readout protection (RDP)) on page 108. Columns: RDP protection level, RDP protection level, Debug, Comments. 3 data row(s).

rows:
OEM and BS unlocking/locking keys can be provisioned in the flash 
memory user options. The keys programming, while not readable, can be 
verified under reset through debugger.

Boot address must target the user flash memory.
Option-byte modification limited, RDP_LEVEL not modifiable hence RDP 
level 2 with boundary scan cannot be changed, unless the OEM unlocking 
key is activated or the BS locking key to progress to level 2 (see Table10).

Boot address must target the user flash memory.

level 2 cannot be changed, unless the OEM unlocking key is activated 
(seeTable10).
